A spontaneous truce on the first Christmas Eve of The Great War allowed that legendary football match to be played on “no-man’s land,” between the German and British lines, by the opposing forces. Back in Britain the Belgrave President, Mr H. Brown, had sent the above patriotic Christmas card to fellow Belgravian A.E.
